purpose: create environments from code so every environment is reproducible, isolated and safe to change
entry_criteria: Environment purpose and ownership are defined
Infrastructure as code exists or is created in this stage (stage 117)
Cloud account and access controls are in place
procedure: Define the environment from code with per-environment parameters; no manual console changes.
Isolate environments by account or project, network and credentials; production credentials never exist in lower environments.
Provision through the pipeline and record the plan and the applied changes.
Seed non-production data with synthetic or properly masked data only.
Verify the environment with health checks and a baseline smoke test.
Tag every resource with owner, purpose and expiry; schedule teardown for temporary environments.
deliverables: resource inventory with owners and expiry
acceptance_criteria: The environment can be destroyed and recreated from code
No production secrets or unmasked customer data exist in it
Resources are tagged with owner and expiry
validation_method: Platform and security review plus a clean pipeline run.

validation.command: terraform plan -detailed-exitcode   # example; exit 0 means code matches reality

validation.check: list resources without an owner tag

failure_modes.detection: Plan shows differences after manual edits
failure_modes.response: Reconcile in code and document the change

failure_modes.mode: Real customer data copied to test
failure_modes.detection: Data scan or review finds real records
failure_modes.response: Delete, mask and report to the data owner
Tear down or extend with a reason

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A short-lived review environment is created for a pull request from code, receives synthetic data, passes smoke checks, and is destroyed automatically when the pull request closes.
